title: POSCUDA: POSITION BASED CONVOLUTION FOR UNLEARNABLE AUDIO DATASETS
benchmark_measurement: This paper does not measure any aspect of faith or religion.
findings: This paper does not contain any findings related to religion. Its focus is on creating unlearnable audio datasets to protect data from being used for model training without authorization.
